content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ANGRAU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ANGRAU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Ph.D. in relevant subject Master's Degree in relevant subject with 4/5 years of Bachelor's degree having first division or equivalent overall grade point average with at least 3 years of respective teaching/research experience as evidenced from Fellowship/Associateship/Training/Other engagements. Published one research paper in Science Citation Index (SCI)/ NAAS rated (>=4.0) Journal. Candidates having Post-Graduate degree in Basic Sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master's degree should have NET qualification. All the Relevant degrees should be completed in the ICAR accredited Universities / Colleges only Minimum 3 years teaching/research experience. B.Sc (Ag)/B.Tech (Ag.Engg.) degree of four years.

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee
content_sections.text: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Teaching Associate: Maximum age limit is 45 years for women and 40 years for men. Teaching Assistant: Maximum age limit is 40 years for women and 35 years for men.

content_sections.heading: ANGRAU Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Teaching Associate: Rs. 61,000/- per month plus applicable HRA* (for Holders) & Rs. 67,000/- per month plus applicable HRA (for Ph. D) Teaching Assistant: Rs.35,000/- consolidated pay per month

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for ANGRAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 28 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for Teaching Associate posts?
faq.answer: For Teaching Associate, candidates need a Ph.D. in a relevant subject or a Master's degree with specific experience and publications. Please refer to the detailed eligibility criteria in the article.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for Teaching Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Teaching Assistant posts is 40 years for women and 35 years for men.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for Teaching Associate positions?
faq.answer: The salary for Teaching Associate ranges from Rs. 61,000/- to Rs. 67,000/- per month, plus applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for Teaching Assistants?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies available for the Teaching Assistant position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for these ANGRAU jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for ANGRAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for these posts.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Regional Agricultural Research Station, Maruteru, West Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh, 534122.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ANGRAU?
faq.answer: Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University has announced a total of 4 vacancies for Teaching Associate and Teaching Assistants posts.
